metrics.definition: NVSS resident all-cause deaths
metrics.current_release: CDC WONDER final Underlying Cause of Death 2018-2024 Single Race, 2024 final release; observations pooled years of death 2020-2024; national age-specific 2024 FastStats seed remains a separate period
metrics.reason_missing: CDC WONDER 2020-2024 final all-cause resident deaths: counts are direct pooled death-year totals; state rates are direct age-specific crude rates per 100,000 summed age-specific person-years. County counts are subject to source suppression (<10). Direct county rates for these ten-year groups are unavailable. Separate derived county-rate metrics use exact matching denominators where available: Census PEP Vintage 2025 ages 1-4 or published WONDER ages 5-9 plus 10-14; they remain null for suppressed deaths or missing denominators. Connecticut 2022-2024 population/rates are unavailable for former county FIPS.

metrics.definition: Observed all-cause registered deaths among U.S. residents; county of residence
metrics.current_release: CDC WONDER 2020-2024 final pooled deaths plus U.S. Census PEP County Vintage 2025 CC-EST2025-SYASEX denominator; rate is separately derived
metrics.reason_missing: Derived county crude rate (not published by CDC WONDER): direct 1-4 county death total divided by the sum of 20 Census PEP Vintage 2025 July 1 population estimates (ages 1-4, years 2020-2024), times 100,000. Source-suppressed deaths and exact-FIPS denominator gaps remain null. County rates use a different population vintage/source than WONDER state rates and are not directly comparable to them. Counts with 1-19 deaths carry the WONDER unreliable-rate flag where the rate is derived. Connecticut's eight legacy county FIPS do not match 2025 Census planning regions and are left without rates.

metrics.reason_missing: This Stats of the States series publishes the 2024 state visualization only. metrics.current_release: CDC WONDER Linked Birth / Infant Death Records, 2017-2024 Expanded (2024 vintage); period-linked observations by death year 2020-2024; fetched 2026-10-04

Counties meeting the cutoff may still have 1-9 death/birth cells suppressed; published rates are marked unreliable when fewer than 20 deaths contribute.
